question: Which locally available models can resolve differences near the ceiling?
why: C-021's gap is 0.0322. A grader that cannot represent a 0.03 difference cannot adjudicate it, and will report 0.0000 -- which reads as a refutation rather than as an instrument limit.
verdict: NO locally available model except qwen38-27B-v2 can adjudicate a near-ceiling contrast. gemma4-31B-mtp emits ONE value there; gemma-4-26B-it emits TWO ({0.5, 1.0}). Neither can represent C-021's 0.0322 gap at all. This is why the claim rests on a single named grader, and it is a measurement rather than an apology.
incomplete: gemma-4-26B-it completed the ceiling band (20/20) and stalled on the mid band at 11/20. The :4000 llama.cpp endpoint stopped answering even a 16-token request for >400s. The ceiling band is the band the C-021 verdict depends on, so the verdict stands; the mid/low bands would have added context about its general behaviour and are recorded as not measured.
criterion_preregistered: fraction_at_1 < 0.95 AND distinct_values > 2, written in PROTOCOL.md before any judgment existed
